protocol.value_prior_only_calibration: regularized sigmoid C=1 on previous dates; raw fallback if one class
protocol.classification: All historical analyses, including reused periods, are exploratory. Not a new independent holdout.
protocol.quality_interpretation: Geometry and rebound proxies are not xG. No confirmed PP1 or actual starter inferred retrospectively.
protocol.reference: Current POINT and GOAL17 algorithms unchanged, refitted per window; not historical emitted probabilities.
protocol.inference_note: 64 planned contrasts across both markets, two endpoints; multiplicity count fixed before aggregate-result inspection. Historical exploration only.
protocol.conversion_gap: Past 10-game goals minus shots times individual conversion rate before those 10 games; >=50 earlier shots. Proxy only, not xG.
